repeats.description: 1D integer array specifying the number of repeats. Must match the length of the repeated axis.

axis.description: integer specifying the axis of ``a`` along which to construct the repeated array. If None (default) then ``a`` is first flattened.

total_repeat_length.description: this must be specified statically for ``jnp.repeat`` to be compatible with :func:`~jax.jit` and other JAX transformations. If ``sum(repeats)`` is larger than the specified ``total_repeat_length``, the remaining values will be discarded. If ``sum(repeats)`` is smaller than ``total_repeat_length``, the final value will be repeated.
constraints: total_repeat_length must be one of jnp.repeat, JAX

output.description: an array constructed from repeated values of ``a``.
